bridges.name: Crystal bridge

chapters: Zone 1: power 2 terminals; the East and North gates open
Zone 2: power 3 terminals; the two drawbridges over the river lower
Zone 3: power 3 terminals; the mine portal opens
The mine: reach the teleporter (dead) and wake the crystal altar; the Highland bridge lights, back in the Bowl
Crystal search: find 20 crystals in the highlands
Crystal gate: offer them; the Crystal bridge lights down into zone 4
Zone 4: the moose puzzle and the altar at the Broken Circle; the South pass gate opens as a shortcut
The crown door in the mine: the deep layer and the crown room
The Starway: from the Broken Circle to the observatory on the peak
